text:
The man is likely to prevail. The recorded right-of-way was an easement appurtenant that merger extinguished when the woman conveyed the house to him and united the dominant and servient estates, and that easement stayed extinguished when he later sold the house. The warranty deed created no new easement, and none arose by necessity or implication: the path was only a more direct route, and the man never possessed or used the house.
CONFIDENCE: 86
